description: Pumping Station Locations is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. A pump station is a holding chamber that pumps liquids to a required area. Using transfer pumps they are installed when liquid is unable to be gravity-fed to the required location. This dataset can be used in conjunction with other related datasets: Drainage Litter Traps Stormwater pits. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are asset, assets, drainage, engineering, pumpingstation. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
